Fixes and cleanup from reviews 7 to 12.

- One `programs.json` now lists the programs of every global settings file; before, only the last settings file's programs were kept
- The other-OS warning is printed on one line, and settings file names come from one data file in push, the pull review and the unknown-files check
- Tests share one set of helpers and fixtures in every package, and each test file is named after its module
- Threat model, ARCHITECTURE and CONTRIBUTING updated to match the code

Install or update: `npm install -g agentnomad@latest` (Node.js 22.13 or newer).
